s.zh: 精灵与卓尔、侏儒与矮人、狗头人与侏儒、地精族与矮人等新增的种族关系心情（只计本殖民地成员与囚犯；有半精灵时精灵与矮人之间的负面心情减半）。关闭后这些新关系不产生心情，1.16.0 已有的精灵/矮人关系不受影响。
s.en: New racial relationship moods such as elf and drow, gnome and dwarf, kobold and gnome, goblinoid and dwarf (only counting this colony's members and prisoners; with a half-elf present, negative moods between elves and dwarves are halved). When off, these new relationships give no mood; the existing 1.16.0 elf/dwarf relationship is unaffected.

s.zh: 狗头人在本殖民地有五色真龙时心情+6、没有龙时-2。关闭后没有这项心情。
s.en: Kobolds get mood +6 when this colony has a chromatic dragon, -2 without dragons. When off, there's no such mood.

s.zh: 需要殖民地里至少有一名狗头人，才能布置狗头人刺坑。
s.en: Needs at least one kobold in the colony to set kobold spike pits.
